parameters.query:
SELECT (jsonb_build_object('RoomNumber', room_number, 'RoomType', room_type, 'Persons', persons, 'Description', description) || extra) AS room
  FROM receply_rooms WHERE account_id = receply_resolve_account($1::jsonb) AND active
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN room_number ~ '^\d+$' THEN lpad(room_number, 12, '0') ELSE room_number END
